intro: Technology and telecommunications sectors faced a concentrated wave of remote-code-execution attacks between April 14 and May 17, 2026, with 16 articles covering 7 high-severity and 9 critical-severity incidents. Key vulnerabilities included CVE-2026-41265, CVE-2026-45185, CVE-2026-5760, CVE-2026-6433 (all CVSS 9.8), and CVE-2026-0300 (CVSS 9.3). The impact was felt globally, with particular focus on Europe and North America, affecting enterprise, government, and software development sectors.
